branding._note: Clickt division system: HiveMind teal primary; Performance volt/moss data accents; Studio plum structural accents; ember attention. Tokens live in template/partials/styles.css.

notes: Google Ads conversion Value = PROFIT (client rule). Efficiency metric renders as POAS, never ROAS.
Meta purchase value = REVENUE. Efficiency metric renders as ROAS.
POAS and ROAS are never blended; the only blended metric is MER (store revenue / total ad spend).

Meta profit = ProfitMetrics profit value carried on the complete-registration event (action_values_complete_registration in Windsor). Google revenue = PM Revenue conversion actions. Channel profit is never estimated.
